metadata.description: Claude Code plugins for Hebrish (hebrish.app), on-device English dictation that writes Hebrew words correctly. Skills for contributors: app development, training data, the website, and outreach.

plugins.name: hebrish-setup
plugins.description: For Hebrish users: install, set up and troubleshoot the Hebrish dictation app on Linux (Ubuntu), and transcribe audio files on the computer through the desktop app's local API. The same skills are published in the open Agent Skills format.

plugins.name: hebrish-maintainers
plugins.description: Every skill for working on Hebrish: app reviews and releases, feature parity and planning, training-data contributions (vocabulary and sentences), website changes and brand assets, outreach, documentation and evaluation (white paper, benchmark pages, charts, running evals), and the Hugging Face organisation (audit, collections, model cards, access requests). Each skill states its access: many need only public repositories; project accounts are needed for Hugging Face, releases, the website repo and outreach.
